ctx.x: Benny Goodman is an institution. Tommy Dorsey, Glenn Miller, they are institutions. So it didn't make much difference what they did, but I think that Sy Oliver gave Tommy a whole new life.
Well, something in the sense of Fletcher being Benny's -- gave

Well, there is no doubt about it. You see, Benny Goodman started a long time before I did and of course, Benny Goodman compared to me, I mean, Benny Goodman was a true genius, at the age of 12 he was a superb clarinet, and I remember -- he was not as involved in jazz as I was, and I remember one time playing with the Pollack band in New York, and we were all sitting around, Glenn Miller, Benny Goodman, Ben Pollack -- But Ben Pollack knew, and I happened to say -- we were talking about a player and I said, 'Well,…
